evidence.title: GitHub - ruucm/shadergradient: Create beautiful moving gradients on Framer, Figma and React

name: Shader Gradient
summary: Customizable 3D moving shader gradients for React, Vue, Framer and Figma, driven by props or preset URLs.
description: Shader Gradient renders animated 3D gradient backgrounds with shaders. v2 ships a lean React renderer (@shadergradient/react) and stateless UI controls (@shadergradient/ui) used by the Framer component and Figma plugin, plus a Vue 3/Nuxt renderer built on TresJS. Settings load from props or a URL copied from the web editor.
contains: @shadergradient/ui stateless control components (ESM bundle, used by the Framer and Figma plugins)
@shadergradient/vue renderer for Vue 3 / Nuxt on TresJS, with SSR-safe canvas
settings driven by props or a URL copied from shadergradient.co/customize
